title: Dataset ranking (corrected): open iEEG datasets with localisation, intervention linkage and outcome - release-bound, outcome-free, RNS subgroup in ds003876
body:
Supersedes A0058-Report. Scope unchanged: open datasets with intracranial EEG + electrode localisation + delivered intervention (resected/ablated contacts or stimulation) + post-intervention outcome. This revision re-binds ds004100 and ds003876 to their cited OpenNeuro releases (A0064, A0065), removes all outcome-derived numbers (participants.tsv and clinical spreadsheets are sealed for this study and were not opened), and corrects the stimulation-arm statement. Verification in this task: OpenNeuro GraphQL snapshot summaries, full snapshot file-tree walks, README/CHANGES/dataset_description/participants.json (dictionary only) and BIDS sidecars. No recordings downloaded.

RANKING BY FIT TO PROTOCOL
1. OpenNeuro ds004100 HUP iEEG, release v1.1.3 (A0064). Best fit for the resection/ablation arm. 57 subjects in the release (README still says 58; sub-HUP132 was dropped at v1.1.0). 1341 files, 14.20 GB, CC0, EDF + BIDS. 319 EDF runs (208 ictal, 111 interictal); SEEG 37 / ECoG 20 by acquisition label. Per-contact coordinates for 57/57; contact-level 'resect' and 'soz' tags in channels.tsv for 57/57. Engel/outcome fields exist per participants.json but are sealed. Caveats: (a) coordinate frame/unit conflict, to_verify by R2: coordsystem.json says fsaverage in metres, README says ICBM152 MNI, and coordinate magnitudes (max 40.7-103.2 per subject) are millimetre-scale; (b) no MRI/CT/DWI, so a template/normative connectome is required; (c) no per-patient follow-up duration in metadata; (d) sub-HUP165 has no ictal run; (e) resection vs laser ablation per subject is only in the sealed participants file; (f) no stimulation cases.
2. Omni-iEEG on Hugging Face (A0040). Large derived aggregate (328 participant rows reported, 339 raw directories, about 159 GB, ungated). Channel-level resection flags and anatomical labels but no coordinates; binary outcome only; data licence not stated. Re-packages ds004100, ds003029, ds003876 and ds003498; its UCLA (50) and Detroit (135) subsets are new but lack coordinates. Its has_resection flag must not be used for the ds003876 rns* subjects (contradicted by the ds003876 README, A0065).
3. OpenNeuro ds003498 Zurich HFO (A0038). 20 subjects, ILAE outcome field and months of follow-up (values sealed); resection-zone contacts in a sourcedata sheet; no coordinates; interictal sleep only. CC0, about 48 GB.
4. OpenNeuro ds003029 Fragility multicenter (A0035). 37 subject directories; Engel/ILAE/follow-up fields (sealed); no electrodes.tsv and no resected-contact tags (surgery type and free-text EZ region only). CC0, about 11.1 GB; Cleveland subset needs a DUA.
5. OpenNeuro ds003876 interictal multicenter, release v1.0.2 (A0065). 39 subjects, 54 interictal EDF runs, CC0, 5.52 GB incl. derivatives (5.37 GB raw BIDS). No coordinates, no ictal data. Intervention linkage by subject group from the README and sidecars: 29 resection/ablation subjects (clinician-estimated 'rz' contacts in 23/29) and 10 RNS-treated subjects (rns002-rns015; no 'rz' column; clinician 'soz' channels in 10/10, 'epz' in 8/10). Low fit for the resection arm.
6. candidate-epivr, Kini 2019 (A0034). n=28 reported; GitHub repo is code only (MIT); data on IEEG.org (access to_verify). Same HUP family as ds004100 and effectively superseded by it.
Modeling-basis sources (e.g. the Wang 2025 VBT capsules recorded earlier) are not validation cohorts and are not re-ranked here.

STIMULATION ARM (corrected)
ds003876 is the only open dataset found with RNS-treated subjects in an outcome-annotated cohort: 10 rns* subjects with pre-implant extraoperative interictal SEEG and clinician SOZ/EPZ channel labels (A0065). What it does NOT contain, in any inspected file: RNS device settings (amplitude, pulse width, frequency, burst, charge density), RNS lead/contact locations, detection parameters, device-recorded or post-implant ECoG, or electrode coordinates. One possible source, sourcedata/ieeg_database_all.xlsx, was not opened because clinical spreadsheets are sealed; its content is to_verify by an authorized review. It is also unknown how outcome fields are coded for RNS subjects (sealed). Conclusion: ds003876 gives a verified RNS treatment-modality label, so the earlier statement that no open data exist for the stimulation arm is withdrawn. But it is not usable to validate stimulation parameters or target geometry. At most it supports a weak, label-level RNS group (SOZ channel sets as an unverified proxy for stimulation targets, no coordinates), conditional on vault confirmation that post-RNS outcome labels exist with adequate follow-up. No open dataset with RNS/DBS/VNS settings or lead locations plus outcome was found. DANDI had no outcome-linked epilepsy sets (unchanged from the earlier search).

COHORT FAMILIES: fam-hup-penn (ds004100, Kini 2019/EpiVR, Omni 'hup'); fam-jhu-sarma-multicenter (ds003029, ds003876, Omni 'Multicenter'/'sourcesink'; README: ds003876 pt1/pt2/pt3/jh103/jh105 = ds003029 pt01/pt2/pt3/jh103/jh105); fam-zurich-fedele2017 (ds003498, Omni 'zurich'); fam-omni-ucla-detroit. Do not pool Omni-iEEG with its source datasets.

LEAKAGE NOTE: outcome values and therapy splits live in participants.tsv / clinical spreadsheets, which are sealed. This report and the cards it cites carry no outcome-derived counts. Release-bound counts (57 for ds004100 v1.1.3; 39 for ds003876 v1.0.2) must be used instead of raw-bucket counts.
